fact: IANOR's draft 2026 national standardisation programme lists ISO/IEC 14651:2025 (information technology, string comparison and collation) as a revision of existing national standard NA 13037, proposed by CNIG; the document gives the programme's publication date, 2026-02-01, as its only date.

Executive decree 98-69 of 21 February 1998 created the Algerian Institute of Standardisation (IANOR), a public industrial and commercial establishment under the industry ministry, charged with drawing up, publishing and disseminating Algerian standards and with adopting conformity marks and authorising their use.
